text:
elena: kicking off evening deploy for feature flag llmroute_v3_fold. change window 21:30-23:00 UTC. goal: safe migration to v3 routing with minimal user impact. plan: shadow 5% traffic to v3 for 20m (no live traffic), then canary sticky 2% in eu-central at 21:50 -> wait 15m -> fold 20% split traffic across v2 & v3 at 22:10 -> hold 30m -> if stable, progressive fold to 60% by 22:50 -> final cutover 23:00. model pinned to model-route v3.2.0 for shadow and ramp phases. quiet-window: no other routing changes 21:00-23:30. @deploybot please orchestrate, @sre-oncall FYI.

deploybot: ack scheduled. steps: 21:30 shadow 5% (read-only), 21:50 canary 2% sticky eu-central, 22:05 check, 22:10 fold 20% split, 22:40 check, 22:50 fold 60%, 23:00 final. will post snapshots and action confirmations.

owen: important rollback triggers: sustained p95 > 420ms (5m) OR error-rate > 0.45% OR token-queue-length > 2x baseline. add fold-specific gate: split traffic imbalance > 5% between v2/v3 success ratios -> pause fold. also track user-facing regression rate (NLP-smoke) > 1.5% absolute.

tara: add semantic gate: quick-eval on 50 curated prompts after shadow and after canary. if drift > 1.8% vs baseline, abort. Also include a soft-drain pattern: if DB or dependent svc error spikes > 20% pause and drop new cohorts to 0% for 3m.

sre-oncall: standing by. i'll mute non-actionable alerts and monitor p95, error-rate, cpu, token-queue-length, dependent DB errors, and eval pass rates. will execute manual rollback if thresholds ambiguous.

deploybot: rollback action configured: set llmroute_v3_fold=off for all cohorts and pin model-route to v2.4.1. ops rollback command for manual use:
/deploybot rollback llmroute_v3_fold --pin-version v2.4.1 --reason "telemetry or eval"

elena: when rolling back, ensure we also revert sticky routing state and clear prefix cache to avoid stale session routing. add note in runbook section "fold->pinback".

deploybot: shadow 5% executed at 21:30 UTC (read-only). shadow metrics snapshot incoming ~21:50.

owen: suggest adding a short client-facing blurb: "Attempting minor routing experiment in eu-central tonight; automatic fallback is in place." keep it minimal.

tara: pre-canary eval running now (shadow baseline comparison). will post results in ~8m.

deploybot: shadow snapshot (21:45): p95=310ms, error-rate=0.07%, cpu=49%, token-queue-length=1.02x. quick-eval drift 0.9% vs baseline. prelim pass.

sre-oncall: looks ok so far. if canary stable at 22:05, proceed with 20% split at 22:10 per plan. I'll be ready to trigger rollback or pause.

elena: thanks team 1: we'll keep tight monitoring and follow runbook on pinback if needed.
